title: Switch a session's model and effort
requirement: a verb switches a running session's model and effort with no side effect on the user's own settings (the CLI's model command writes the user-scope model key, so it is not the channel); the console reaches it through its actions
acceptance: Switching a running session's model and effort takes effect for its next turn and leaves the user's own settings byte-identical; the console reaches the switch by keyboard alone.
